visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged Asian man with short black hair wearing a light blue button-up shirt sits at a wooden desk. In front of him is a black laptop with various stickers, including a red octagonal sign that reads "Never Stop Improving." He looks directly at the camera, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. The background is a plain white wall featuring a framed picture on the left and some cartoon wall decals. A cartoon avatar of a woman's face is positioned in the bottom left corner as a static overlay. (2) The scene transitions to a dimly lit underground parking lot with concrete pillars and rows of parked cars. A woman with short blonde hair, wearing a brown jacket and a patterned skirt, pushes a metal shopping cart filled with bags and paper items. The camera follows her from a side angle as she walks through the large space, which is illuminated by fluorescent tube lights. (3) Back in the indoor office setting, the man continues his explanation. He uses varied hand gestures, occasionally pointing or holding his palms up, to emphasize his verbal points. The lighting is bright and even studio lighting. He maintains eye contact with the lens, showing subtle facial expressions like raised eyebrows and smiles that match his energetic speech patterns. (4) A series of quick cuts showing specific objects: first, a dark wooden gavel strikes a circular sounding block on a desk in high-contrast cinematic lighting. This is followed by a close-up of a 3D printer's extruder head moving rapidly over a build plate, with technical light reflecting off the metallic parts. Then, a pair of hands is shown flipping through the pages of a comic book with black ink illustrations on white paper. (5) The video returns to the man at the desk. A large, colorful cartoon image of Doraemon (the blue robotic cat) appears as a graphic overlay next to him. He continues to speak animatedly. Later, a scene shows three young girls—one with glasses and two with blonde hair—huddled together in a room with atmospheric teal and pink lighting, focused on reading a book. The video ends with the man resting his chin on his hands, looking thoughtfully at the camera while a text prompt appears.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 欸老湯. [Logo]: 臺灣吧. (2) [Subtitle]: 臺灣什麼時候 開始看 漫畫. (3) [Subtitle]: 日治時期 就開始了. (4) [Subtitle]: 不過那個時候看漫畫 可沒那麼容易. (5) [Subtitle]: 那時候沒有 獨立的書店. (6) [Subtitle]: 租漫畫都是 流動型書店. [Variety]: 竟然沒有漫畫店?! (7) [Subtitle]: 沒錯 戰後開始有 獨立的漫畫店. (8) [Subtitle]: 不過大家知道 戰後在 戒嚴. (9) [Subtitle]: 不是你想看什麼漫畫 就能看. (10) [Subtitle]: 特別在 1966 年. (11) [Subtitle]: 政府開始強力的執行 編印連環漫畫輔導辦法. (12) [Subtitle]: 規定就是要有 教育意涵. [Variety]: 太乾了吧 太過規定了吧. (13) [Subtitle]: 沒錯 而且要執行這個規定 就代表漫畫需要送審. (14) [Subtitle]: 這審查費 甚至比漫畫定價 貴了 40 倍. [Variety]: 天哪 作者畫漫畫前 要先吃土喔?. (15) [Subtitle]: 很多人在 1966 年以後 就沒辦法再從事 漫畫相關的工作. (16) [Subtitle]: 臺灣的漫畫產業 就進入一個 大斷層的時代. (17) [Subtitle]: 臺灣還是有看漫畫需求 所以日本的盜版漫畫 就開始盛行在臺灣. (18) [Subtitle]: 大家現在熟悉 哆啦 A 夢 以前我都叫 小叮噹. (19) [Subtitle]: 這就是 盜版 的結果. [Variety]: 竟然跟盜版有關系. (20) [Subtitle]: 解嚴以後臺灣漫畫走向自由 但畢竟經歷過 大斷層的時代. (21) [Subtitle]: 要讓臺灣的漫畫產業復興 可能還需要一些時間. (22) [Subtitle]: 不過現在也越來越多 臺灣本土漫畫作品出來. (23) [Subtitle]: 希望大家可以多多支持. (24) [Slogan]: 留言「漫畫」 就告訴你更多相關內容哦.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-tempo, energetic pop/electronic BGM featuring a steady synth bassline and percussion. A female voice with a bright, questioning inflection asks about the history of Taiwanese comics. Immediately, a male narrator responds with a professional, enunciated tone, speaking rapidly. (2) A low-frequency metallic rattling sound (shopping cart) is heard, mixed under the continuous BGM and the male voice. The narrator maintains a high energy level with frequent pitch modulations to keep the listener engaged as he describes historical bookstores. (3) A sharp, resonant 'thud' sound effect, simulating a gavel striking wood, cuts through the mix. This is followed by a higher-frequency mechanical whirring sound (3D printer). The BGM remains constant, providing a driving rhythmic pace. (4) Distinct sounds of paper rustling and fast page-flipping occur, synchronized with visual transitions. A clear, electronic 'ding' sound effect is used for emphasis. The male narrator's voice carries a tone of authoritative storytelling, shifting slightly in pitch during dramatic reveals. (5) In the final phase, the BGM volume swells slightly during a transition before dipping back. The narrator provides a concluding call to action with a friendly and inviting tone. The audio track ends with a clean fade-out of the music following the final spoken phrase.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Historical Context -> Conflict (Martial Law) -> Consequence (Piracy) -> Hope/Future -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate the audience on the historical development of the comic book industry in Taiwan, specifically explaining how government regulations during the martial law era led to a stagnation of local industry and the subsequent rise of Japanese pirate versions.
